review.decision_rule: Search results may nominate a candidate, but every entry below is an explicit review decision tied to a shipped surface and owner path. Unlisted search hits are not implicitly approved.

entries.decision: Good Bear is the public application name; it is independent product identity.
entries.review_basis: Good Bear branding owner inputs and product identity contract.

entries.decision: M10-03 supplies the selected original Good Bear primary mark in every declared Ubuntu icon size; the mark has no enclosing circular device.
entries.review_basis: BRANDING.md section 5.3 and product identity artwork policy.

entries.decision: M10-04 binds the independent goodbear-browser package name to the goodbear executable without changing compatibility identifiers or the Russian-only release contract.
entries.review_basis: Product identity compatibility and Ubuntu-only packaging contract.

entries.decision: Ubuntu package and launcher consume the approved original Good Bear artwork in the declared icon sizes.
entries.review_basis: BRANDING.md sections 5.2, 5.3, and 7.

entries.decision: The About surface names Good Bear and its creator; M10-06 owns public author links and final legal copy.
entries.review_basis: BRANDING.md section 20 and LEGAL.md sections 1 and 6.

entries.decision: Mozilla Firefox appears here only as truthful upstream provenance and must remain distinguishable from Good Bear identity.
entries.review_basis: LEGAL.md sections 4 through 6; this is not a product mark to erase.

entries.decision: The About window resolves its branding through the Good Bear branding directory; M10-03 audits any concrete mascot or logo asset separately.
entries.review_basis: Firefox branding build owner and Good Bear product identity patch.

entries.decision: Generic onboarding instructions are functional UI copy; product-specific references require an explicit later review, not a blanket rename.
entries.review_basis: AboutWelcome owner path reviewed against the public onboarding surface.

entries.decision: M10-03 replaces each audited Firefox-specific onboarding fox/logo/animation surface with an original selected Good Bear asset; the upstream files are not packaged by the modified jar manifest.
entries.review_basis: BRANDING.md sections 4, 6, and 7; LEGAL.md section 4.4.

entries.decision: Network and certificate error language remains functional security UI; M10 artwork work must not change its technical meaning.
entries.review_basis: BRANDING.md sections 8, 13, and 14.

entries.decision: Generic information and warning icons are neutral functional UI, not Mozilla product identity.
entries.review_basis: BRANDING.md section 4 prohibits brand marks, not independently licensed neutral UI icons.

entries.decision: M10-03 replaces the Firefox fox connection/certificate-error illustrations with original Good Bear generic-error artwork. Its alpha content is contained in a machine-verified transparent safe zone and its reserved flex column cannot cover the title, warning icon, body, controls, or certificate details. It remains decorative product identity only; neutral warning and trust icons remain unchanged.
entries.review_basis: toolkit/content/errors/net-error-illustrations.mjs explicitly maps these two public error-page assets; BRANDING.md sections 4, 6, 7, 8, 13, and 14; LEGAL.md section 4.4.

entries.decision: M10-03 replaces audited Firefox fox artwork in public private-browsing and account-adjacent UI with original Good Bear assets.
entries.review_basis: BRANDING.md sections 6, 7, and 14; LEGAL.md section 4.

entries.decision: In-application updates and Mozilla release-note endpoints are disabled; Ubuntu package management is the declared delivery path.
entries.review_basis: Product identity services contract and Ubuntu distribution boundary.

entries.absence_reason: The in-application updater is disabled, so Good Bear 1.0 has no enabled public update artwork surface.
entries.decision: No asset is approved by absence: enabling an update surface requires a new reviewed inventory entry.
entries.review_basis: Product identity services contract.

entries.decision: M10-04 generates the com.ledovskoy.goodbear.desktop launcher with Good Bear branding, the goodbear command, and independently named installed icons.
entries.review_basis: BRANDING.md section 21 and Ubuntu packaging owner path.

entries.decision: The launcher consumes the selected original Good Bear artwork in all declared Ubuntu sizes.
entries.review_basis: BRANDING.md sections 5.2, 5.3, 7, and 21.

entries.decision: The Firefox application ID, version and UA product token are preserved narrowly for compatibility and must never be rendered as Good Bear product identity.
entries.review_basis: Product identity compatibility dispositions and LEGAL.md section 5.

entries.decision: The Windows installer presents Good Bear as its product name; Russian wizard text is supplied by the pinned Firefox Russian locale and is verified in the native installer gate.
entries.review_basis: M12-03 Windows installer contract and Russian single-locale release requirement.

entries.decision: The Windows NSIS welcome and finish pages use a deterministic derivative of the approved original Good Bear welcome mascot. The three resources retain the upstream NSIS dimensions but are verified not to equal Firefox artwork.
entries.review_basis: M10-03 approved Workshop Beacon artwork; NSIS resource dimensions in browser/installer/windows/Makefile.in.
